definitions.explanation: The demographic shift toward an older average age in a population.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高齢化|こうれいか}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{高齢化|こうれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}→医療費：24692_iryouhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: As the population ages, medical costs increase.

examples.japanese: {高齢化|こうれいか}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{高齢化|こうれいか} describes the demographic shift toward an older population. The suffix ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ indicates a process of change.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {高齢化|こうれいか}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: aging society
- ⟦{超|ちょう}→超：noentry⟧{高齢化|こうれいか}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: super-aged society
- ⟦{少子|しょうし}→少子：28618_shoushi⟧{高齢化|こうれいか}: declining birthrate and aging population
- {高齢化|こうれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: aging progresses
- {高齢化|こうれいか}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: aging rate

USAGE:
Japan has one of the highest rates of population aging in the world. The paired term ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧ (declining birthrate) is almost always discussed alongside it. Together, ⟦{少子|しょうし}→少子：28618_shoushi⟧{高齢化|こうれいか} is a major social and economic issue frequently appearing in news and policy discussions.
